description: The rules that turn an employee's penalty points into a level: a colour for the list view and the action that level demands. Held as data rather than code so HR can change a threshold or a colour without a deployment.

fields.description: What this level is called, e.g. Warning
fields.label: Level

fields.description: This level applies from this many points. The highest band an employee reaches wins, so the bands are read from the top down.
fields.label: From Points

fields.description: Optional. Leave blank for 'this many points and above'. Set it to cap the band, e.g. 2 to 5.
fields.label: To Points

fields.description: Colours the left-hand indicator on the Employee list. Green through red.
fields.label: List Indicator
fields.options:
Green
Blue
Yellow
Orange
Red
Purple
Grey

fields.description: Used on the employee card and the dashboard tile. Keep it consistent with the indicator so the two never disagree.
fields.label: Colour

fields.description: What HR must do when an employee reaches this level. Shown on the Employee form, so the rule travels with the person rather than living in a policy document.
fields.label: Action Required

fields.description: Optional. Anything that escalates at this level beyond the action, e.g. who is notified.
fields.label: Escalation Note

fields.description: Display order, lowest band first. Only affects the order levels are listed in; which band applies is decided by from_points.
fields.label: Sort Order

name: SDG Penalty Level
